writes.name: route.request
writes.value: I request that this court set aside the conviction identified below. I state the following facts in support of this motion:

writes.name: offense.selectedAllegation
writes.value: The identified offense is prostitution-related within subsection (1). I was a victim of sex trafficking at the time of the offense.

writes.name: offense.account
writes.label: Supporting factual account:
writes.value: I was a victim of sex trafficking when I committed the identified prostitution-related offense. This is a synthetic sample account for review.

writes.name: route.relief
writes.value: I ask the court to make the findings required by the selected statutory branch and grant the motion.
